purpose: Define BeBee's local HTML5 save envelope, two-generation recovery protocol, size budgets, durability semantics and P0/P8 storage test matrix before production persistence code exists.

local_adapter.selection_rule: Load and validate both slots. If both are valid, select the highest generation. If one is valid, recover from it. If valid generations tie with identical canonical payload, either is acceptable; if generations tie with differing payload, report generation_conflict and preserve both before deterministic fallback.
local_adapter.write_rule: Write the next generation to the invalid, missing, or lower-generation slot; never overwrite the sole highest valid generation first.
local_adapter.repair_rule: Recovery may continue from one valid slot. Do not immediately overwrite the invalid peer during load; repair only through the next explicit successful save/checkpoint so forensic evidence is preserved for diagnostics.
local_adapter.delete_rule: Explicit reset/delete removes both generation slots. Partial deletion is reported as an error and retried/diagnosed rather than treated as a complete reset. On Defold HTML5, unlink does not pass through the FS.close persistence hook, so the backend explicitly requests the loader's coalesced persistent sync after successful deletion/temporary-file cleanup.

payload_rules: derived values omitted when safely recomputable
campaign-native completion separate from planted/customization state
economy values pass domain invariants before serialization
unknown optional fields tolerated only when schema validator explicitly allows them

size_budget.portal_cloud_limit_note: Current Poki cloud gamesave limit is 1 MB after gzip, but BeBee must obey the stricter Defold/local budget and may not rely on portal compression to justify large saves.
size_budget.policy: A save at or above the release gate fails release validation unless an explicit evidence-backed technical decision changes the budget. Runtime must never intentionally approach the Defold ceiling.

durability.html5_backend: browser virtual filesystem backed by IndexedDB
durability.defold_sync_mechanism: Defold HTML5 patches FS.close to start a coalesced asynchronous Module.persistentSync()/FS.syncfs(false) MEM-to-IndexedDB operation.
durability.gameplay_rule: A visibly granted durable progression reward triggers a save checkpoint, but UI must not claim browser-durable persistence that the adapter cannot prove.
durability.navigation_rule: Do not intentionally navigate/reload immediately after critical progression when avoidable; P0 tests the unavoidable rapid-refresh/close window.
durability.rapid_window_acceptance: For an accepted_local_pending_browser_persistence generation raced by immediate refresh/close, PASS means reload yields either that latest generation or the last previously confirmed persistent generation through explicit recovery metadata. Clean-start, corruption, unknown state, or an older-than-last-confirmed generation fails. This does not relabel the pending write as durable.

load_pipeline: resolve both save paths with protected error handling
pcall sys.load for slot A and slot B independently
distinguish missing empty table from corrupt/error
validate envelope format_version and positive generation
run sequential migrations on a copy/in-memory candidate
select highest valid generation or apply documented conflict/recovery rule
return state plus recovery/diagnostic metadata without overwriting either slot during load
save_pipeline: build envelope with next positive generation
measure/estimate serialized output using the P0 diagnostic path
reject release-gate violation before replacing a valid generation
pcall sys.load target slot for readback verification
only then report save accepted; preserve previous valid slot
on HTML5 report pending browser persistence rather than false durable confirmation

migration.public_version_rule: Every previously public save_version must have a tested migration path or an explicit unsupported-version product decision before release.
migration.idempotence_expectation: A completed migration result validates consistently when loaded again; migration steps must not duplicate rewards or purchases.
migration.migration_failure_rule: Preserve original slot bytes/state evidence and fail to recovery/clean-start policy; never overwrite the only valid pre-migration generation with a failed migration.

poki.incognito_requirement: Game remains playable when browser storage is restricted/unavailable; storage operations fail explicitly and gameplay uses the defined degraded behavior rather than crashing.
poki.current_cloud_observation: Poki documents monitoring localStorage and IndexedDB for cloud gamesaves.
poki.rule: Portal cloud behavior is an adapter/platform capability; local generation/recovery correctness must work without an account or cloud sync.

p0_exit_requirements: local adapter implemented behind storage service
normal and immediate-refresh HTML5 persistence tests pass under the documented pending-durability rapid-window invariant
failed write/readback proves previous valid generation survives
storage failure does not crash gameplay
